 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Satyavrat Verma
 Oral Order
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in connection with Yogapatti P.S. Case No. 318 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 147,
148, 324, 341, 504, 506, 379, 354B, 494, 498A and 34 of the Indian Penal Code .
3. It is next submitted that investigation in the case is still going on.

4. The learned APP submits that the offence for which the instant FIR has been instituted, carries punishment of seven years or less, the said submission of the learned APP is not Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.25332 of 2024(2) dt.16-04-2024 disputed by learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner.

5. In view of the submission made by the learned APP, the anticipatory bail application is disposed of in terms of the order dated 13-2-2024 passed in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 (Naushad Ansari vs. the State of Bihar).
